name: Go Fish
summary: Simple family card game where players ask opponents for ranks to collect four-of-a-kind books.
rules_text: Use a standard 52-card deck. For 2-3 players deal 7 cards each, for 4-5 players deal 5 cards each face down. Place the rest face down as stock. On your turn, choose an opponent and a rank of which you hold at least one card and ask for all cards of that rank, e.g. 'Give me your kings'. If the opponent has any, they must give them all, you show the catch and keep asking, same or different rank or player. If you complete four of a kind, lay the book face up and continue. If the opponent has none, they say 'Go fish' and you draw the top card of the stock. If that draw is not the rank you asked for, your turn ends and play passes left. If a player runs out of cards on their turn they draw one from stock if possible, otherwise they are out. Game ends when all 13 books are claimed. Most books wins.
rating_reason: Classic hidden-hand asking game, opponent modelling, turn-based
